facts.fact: 名字揭晓：Louise——「Lou」一声，两个人抱头痛哭。
facts.anchor: All we can do is stare at Louise standing on our doorstop, a smile frozen on her face.

facts.fact: 她的版本：精神崩溃——遇人、分手、撑不住就跑了；「一直在自我修复」。
facts.anchor: That was her explanation, but honestly, I’m finding it hard to believe.

facts.fact: Blair 追问去向：到处搬家、旅行——只换来两个字「真方便」。
Cassie 的自责：当年该察觉的——毕竟「我最懂这种事」。
facts.anchor: She never showed any warning signs, and I would have picked up on even the smallest hint of something being wrong. After all, I would know.

facts.fact: 新计划：三只眼好过两只——拉 Louise 一起查报道里那个失踪女孩。
facts.anchor: Three eyes on the ground must be better than two. Maybe we can all work together to find the missing girl from the article.

facts.fact: Blair 一票否决：我们杀了人——她绝不能沾；说完整了摔门而去。
facts.anchor: ‘Because we fucking murdered someone. Nobody can know. I mean it, Cassie. She’s not getting involved.’
